text:
Rina Kato: Hi everyone 2f Im Rina, joining as an SRE on the serving runtime team. First day stuff mostly done but hitting a quick snag with SSH access to the internal jump host (permission denied). Also hello! Fun fact: I used to renovate vintage bicycles. :bicycle:

Alex Chen: welcome Rina!! For the jump host, what's the exact SSH command and error?

Rina Kato: `ssh rina@jump.internal.redwood` returns `Permission denied (publickey).` I added my public key in the profile but may have uploaded the wrong key.

Priya Rao: People Ops here 2f did you upload `id_ed25519.pub` or `id_rsa.pub`? We expect ed25519 keys by default. If you uploaded the wrong one, delete and re-upload from https://okta.redwood.com/profile/ssh-keys.

Rina Kato: ah I uploaded id_rsa.pub. Replacing with id_ed25519.pub now. Thanks!

Marco Silva: while you do that, if you need immediate access we can create a jump-token for 2 hours. @Rina Kato DM me your employee email and I'll spin one up. Also FYI the jump host uses `AllowUsers` so the username must match your SSO handle (no nicknames).

Rina Kato: DM'd Marco 2f key updated and SSH now connects! That was fast, thanks. Quick question: where are the onboarding runbooks for local perf tests? Trying to run the small-suite smoke tests.

Alex Chen: runbooks are in `docs/onboarding/sre` in the monorepo. For the perf smoke: `make smoke-test && ./tools/run_smoke --ci` — if you hit dependency issues run `scripts/bootstrap-dev.sh` first.

Rina Kato: got it, thanks. Also shirt size: L. Two truths & a lie: I once rode a motorcycle across a country, I speak three languages, I hate pizza. Guess which is the lie? :thinking_face:

Priya Rao: I'm betting you don't hate pizza.

Marco Silva: lie is the motorcycle?

Rina Kato: correct on pizza 2f I love pizza. The motorcycle one is true (Italy coast to coast), I speak three languages. :pizza:

People Ops Bot: @Rina Kato added to #new-hires. Onboarding checklist updated (3/6). Welcome to Redwood Inference! :tada:
